name: Toilet-Bound Hanako-kun
description: To be united with her crush, a hopeless romantic summons the ghost in the girls' bathroom at her school. But she's shocked when the ghost is a boy!

videos.title: Hanako-san of the Bathroom
videos.overview: Yashiro Nene is looking for ghostly help with her love life, but when "Hanako-san," the wish-granting spirit that haunts a girls’ bathroom stall, turns out to be a boy, she may end up getting more, and less, than she bargained for.

videos.title: Yousei-san
videos.overview: A rash of mysterious thefts hits the school, and rumor has it that the apparition "Yousei-san" is behind it. When Nene catches sight of the creature, will she end up losing more than just her school supplies?

videos.title: The Misaki Stairs (1)
videos.overview: Nene’s best friend vanishes without a trace and no one else remembers she ever existed! To get her friend back, Nene is forced to call on Hanako for help and journey into a "Boundary" between the world of the living and the world of the dead.

videos.title: The Misaki Stairs (2)
videos.overview: Nene, Hanako, and Kou have reached the top of the Misaki Stairs, where a mysterious and bewitching woman awaits them. Will Nene get her friend back, or will she vanish along with her?

videos.title: The Confession Tree
videos.overview: The school is full on unlikely couples thanks to a tree that rumor has it makes any confession made under it succeed. When Hanako asks Nene to meet him there, Nene starts to suspect that he sees her as more than an assistant.

videos.title: The 4 O’clock Library
videos.overview: In search of Hanako’s secrets, Nene and Kou enter the fifth Wonder, the 4 O’clock Library. Its books contain the past and future of every student their school has ever had, but some knowledge comes at a price.

videos.title: Donuts
videos.overview: Nene’s relationship with Hanako becomes strained after she learns about his past. With some baking help from Kou, she tries to talk things out with Hanako over donuts, but their heart-to-heart is interrupted by a shocking intruder!

videos.title: Mitsuba
videos.overview: Kou gets more than he bargained for when he tries to help a student’s ghost rest in peace. The late Mitsuba may look delicate, but his language is anything but. Can Kou put up with him long enough to help him?

videos.title: Tea Party
videos.overview: After a surprise invitation, Nene finds herself kidnapped and taken to... a fancy tea party? Nene quickly drops her guard in coversation with the beautiful and mysterious Sakura, but is their meeting as innocent as it seems?

videos.title: The Hell of Mirrors (1)
videos.overview: Nene finds disembodied hands appearing in her old club photos! Then, hands start sprouting around her in real life too! They seem harmless, but is there something sinister behind them?

videos.title: The Hell of Mirrors (2)
videos.overview: Tsukasa rescues Nene and Mitsuba from the Hell of Mirrors, but does the mercurial ghost have something worse in store for them? Meanwhile, Hanako and Kou race to find a way to follow Nene, but will they make it in time?

videos.title: The Little Mermaid
videos.overview: Nene made it back from the Hell of Mirrors in one piece, but she worries about what Hanako may be hiding from her. Just then, strange fish appear, calling her their princess and asking her to join them as the mermaid’s successor.

videos.title: Hanako-kun of the Bathroom
videos.overview: Sudden, rapid aging wreaks havoc in Nene's and Kou's school lives. Hanako identifies the culprit as a fellow Wonder: the three Clock Keepers, rumored to control time at Kamome Academy. The trio set out to punish the offending apparition, but they'll have to find them first.

videos.title: The Three Clock Keepers
videos.overview: One of the Clock Keepers stands revealed... as Nene's classmate Aoi Akane. Hanako proposes they work together to set things right, but past experiences have left Akane with little trust for apparitions.

videos.title: Lost and Found
videos.overview: Nene doesn't have long to live. While Kou struggles with the revelation, Nene goes about her day none the wiser. Only she can't seem to find Hanako.

videos.title: Summer Lights
videos.overview: Nene tries to lift Kou's spirits by inviting him to a summer festival, but Hanako has other ideas.

videos.title: Mokke of the Dead / The Melancholy of the New Number Three
videos.overview: A mokke escapes containment. Its bite brings disaster. Now they hunger... for candy.

videos.title: Make Believe
videos.overview: Nene gets to school only to find Hanako sitting in her class. Why are her friends acting like he belongs?

videos.title: Make Sense
videos.overview: Faced with an impossible school life, Nene and Kou enter a mysterious tower to seek the truth within.

videos.title: Make It Sound Nice
videos.overview: Shijima told Nene to kill Amane. Tsukasa told Nene to kill Amane. Amane took Nene stargazing.

videos.title: Make It Secret
videos.overview: Nene drags Amane out of school and away from Shijima, but escaping a Wonder is easier said than done.

videos.title: Make a Wish
videos.overview: When Hanako reveals the truth, Kou gets confused. Nene gets angry.

videos.title: Make It About You
videos.overview: Like Nene, the living Shijima is facing her own mortality, but she confronts her future—and her other self.

videos.title: Picture Perfect
videos.overview: Nene sets out to leave the painting for good, but Hanako has other ideas.

videos.title: Final Exams and a School Sleepover
videos.overview: Nene's life may be coming to an end, but school has her more worried than death.

videos.title: The Near Shore and the Far Shore
videos.overview: Nene and Akane race to rescue Aoi, only to land in hot water themselves.

videos.title: The Reaper's Sacrifice
videos.overview: Nene and friends find Aoi, but she doesn't seem quite her usual self.

videos.title: Sumire
videos.overview: Nene and Hanako find themselves in an unfamiliar place. A strange girl rescues them from masked villagers.

videos.title: Aoi and Akane
videos.overview: While Nene and Hanako get their bearings, Aoi and Akane grapple with more personal problems.

videos.title: Severance
videos.overview: Hanako grants Nene's wish, and she's not happy about how. Now she faces a world without apparitions.

videos.title: Encounters
videos.overview: Nene and Kou retrace Mitsuba's footsteps, looking for a way back to the Boundary.

videos.title: The Red House
videos.overview: Nene and Kou may have found the clue they're looking for in a cursed house. But can they leave with it alive?

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: While Teru hunts for clues at a local shrine, Nene scrambles to escape an eerily familiar cave.

videos.title: Tsukasa and Amane
videos.overview: Kou believes they can make everything right by rescuing four-year-old Tsukasa from the Red House.

videos.title: One-way Train to the Far Shore
videos.overview: While Nene and friends prepare to enter the Boundary, their friends on the other side run into trouble.

videos.title: Wishes
videos.overview: Nene and Kou scramble to save Hanako from Teru's wrath while the Boundary collapses around them.
